svg.text: Update stock and dates through a
Strategic Rationale (SR) • Six enterprise capabilities and stakeholder rationale
Sprint 2 • Draft for group review • 17 November 2026
Marketplace rationale: each capability has its own achievement goal.
Actor-level dependencies retain the same meaning and IDs as the SD view.
Order branch: only after an order is accepted.
Concern branch: only when a concern is reported.
Boundary links intentionally refer to actors; no internal depender/dependee element is asserted. Rationale bindings are described in the model and traceability table.
D-shaped dependency markers point from the depender, through the dependum, to the dependee. This is dependency direction, not a message flow.
SR: T-head = AND refinement; arrow = OR refinement; open circle = needed-by; help / hurt arrows express qualitative design judgements.
SD and SR use the same 5 actors and 19 dependencies. F1/F2 are the operational focus; orders, finance, quality and community remain enterprise context.
